1f4e8.png is Twemoji 15.0.0 incoming envelope (📨), from @twemoji/svg 15.0.0.
Source sprite: shared/emoji/sheet-6.png in joswayski/caper at
https://github.com/joswayski/caper/commit/54910cbf71cb84b8e1419972b837ec6723f68757
The sprite was rasterized from the original SVG by that revision's
scripts/native-emoji.mjs. This file is its unmodified 64×64 RGBA tile at
x=832, y=832, cropped with ImageMagick:
  magick sheet-6.png -crop 64x64+832+832 +repage PNG32:1f4e8.png
Web and native clients display the same artwork at 32 logical pixels.
Android/Apple resource copies must remain byte-identical to this web PNG.
